name: send_telegram_message
description: Send a Telegram message to the current user. Use MarkdownV2 syntax: *bold*, _italic_, __underline__, ~strike~, ||spoiler||, `code`, [text](url), and > blockquote. Reserved chars (_*[]()~`>#+-=|{}.!) must be backslash-escaped outside formatting entities. Returns ok=true once delivered. Use this for proactive messages (reports, check-ins); inbound-reply formatting goes through Scribe.

text.description: MarkdownV2-formatted message body. Keep under ~1500 chars for readability.
